WITH champion_raw AS (
    SELECT
        r.year,
        SUBSTR(res.time, 1, INSTR(res.time, ':') - 1) AS hour_part,
        SUBSTR(res.time, INSTR(res.time, ':') + 1) AS minute_second_part
    FROM races AS r
    INNER JOIN results AS res
        ON r.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE r.year < 1975
      AND res.position = 1
      AND res.time IS NOT NULL
),
champion_seconds AS (
    SELECT
        year,
        CAST(hour_part AS REAL) * 3600
        + CAST(SUBSTR(minute_second_part, 1, INSTR(minute_second_part, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
        + CAST(SUBSTR(minute_second_part, INSTR(minute_second_part, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS time_seconds
    FROM champion_raw
)
SELECT
    year,
    AVG(time_seconds) AS average_time_seconds
FROM champion_seconds
GROUP BY
    year
HAVING
    AVG(time_seconds) IS NOT NULL;

1481.result:
WITH selected AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND y.Consumption = (
            SELECT MIN(y2.Consumption)
            FROM yearmonth AS y2
            JOIN customers AS c2
              ON y2.CustomerID = c2.CustomerID
            WHERE c2.Currency = 'CZK'
              AND c2.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
              AND y2.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      )
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_entries,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS sme_sum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS lam_sum,
        SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS kam_sum
    FROM selected
)
SELECT
    (1.0 * sme_sum / NULLIF(total_entries, 0)) -
    (1.0 * lam_sum / NULLIF(total_entries, 0)) AS SME_minus_LAM,

    (1.0 * lam_sum / NULLIF(total_entries, 0)) -
    (1.0 * kam_sum / NULLIF(total_entries, 0)) AS LAM_minus_KAM,

    (1.0 * kam_sum / NULLIF(total_entries, 0)) -
    (1.0 * sme_sum / NULLIF(total_entries, 0)) AS KAM_minus_SME
FROM agg;
